Package com.github.autoscaler.api

Class ScalingConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.github.autoscaler.api.ScalingConfiguration
public final class ScalingConfiguration extends Object
This object is returned by a ServiceSource and used by the autoscale application in determining how to scale a service.
